operators.name: greater_than
semantics: Element-wise comparison x1 > x2, matching torch.gt exactly.
Output dtype is torch.bool, same shape as inputs.
Supports non-contiguous strides by using actual strides in kernel.
No broadcasting needed because reference expects same shapes but kernel should support broadcasting like torch.gt for safety.

operators.name: concatenate_dim1

returns.shape: concatenated along dim=1, e.g., [N, C1+C2, H, W]

semantics: Output shape is [N, C1+C2, H, W] where C1 and C2 are channel dimensions of x1 and x2 respectively.
Preserves float32 dtype and CUDA device.
Supports non-contiguous strides by computing output strides accordingly.
Element-wise greater-than comparison between x1 and x2.
Result is boolean tensor with same shape as inputs.
Device moves to cuda as execution device.
Concatenate x1 and x2 along channel dimension (dim=1).
Result is float32 tensor with shape [N, C1+C2, H, W].
Return a tuple containing the boolean mask and concatenated tensor.
Both tensors are on CUDA device.
